# validate/decode_terminal_not_last — a byte-transform after the terminal
# decoder is rejected: the terminal must be the last stage.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}

response:
  decode:
    - json: {}
    - gzip: {}
  events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
response.decode[0]: error: only byte-transform stages (gzip|zip) may precede the terminal decoder, got "json"
response.decode[1]: error: the last decode stage must be a terminal decoder (csv|json|ndjson), got "gzip"
